## Change

Describe the problem, Fabric reproduction, and implementation.

## Validation

Record commands and gameplay checks performed, dependency versions, and anything
not verified.

## Documentation impact

- [ ] Player features/instructions updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] Developer architecture/contracts updated where implementation changes.
- [ ] Generated reference refreshed and wiki checks passed.
- [ ] If no prose update is needed, the reason is explained below.

## Licensing

- [ ] Existing license and attribution notices preserved; new third-party
      material has compatible licensing and required attribution.
